verdict.rationale: LegalOS is a software platform with AI workflows, so headless or API-driven automation is a fair question. The evidence only describes guided intake flows, attorney review, and web-based calculators and checkers. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt, and nothing documents a CLI, API, or CI-runnable mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
